    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            union = len(key_sets[i] | key_sets[j])
            inter = len(key_sets[i] & key_sets[j])
            s = inter / union if union > 0 else 1.0
            matrix[i][j] = s

    np.fill_diagonal(matrix, 1.0)

    for ks in key_sets:
